note: Popov-Chang syndrome and pathogenic YWHAZ variants are consistently defined across literature by global developmental delay, intellectual disability, and impaired speech development.

evidence.text: YWHAZ mutation was identified in affected family members with intellectual disability and global developmental delay, confirming its role as a neurodevelopmental disorder gene.

source.title: YWHAZ variation causes intellectual disability and global developmental delay with brain malformation
source.quote: To investigate the role of YWHAZ gene in intellectual disability and global developmental delay, we conducted whole-exon sequencing in all of the available members from a large three-generation family and we discovered that a novel variant of the YWHAZ gene was associated with intellectual disability and global developmental delay.

evidence.text: Variants in YWHAZ have been documented to present with developmental delay and intellectual disability phenotypes.
